question.text: If the radius of the circle passing through the origin and touching the line <math><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn></math> at <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1,1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>r</mi></math> units, then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mi>r</mi></math> is

solution.text:
Family of circles touching the given line at the given point is
x-12+y-12+λx+y-2=0
It passes through 0,0, hence 2-2λ=0⇒λ=1
So, the equation of the circle is
x2+y2-x-y=0
Radius =12
